values.note: Village of Ellsworth: RV site with water and electric $35 a night, $210 a week, $630 a month, $3,150 for the season (May 15 - Sept 30); tent sites $25 a night. One rate for everyone. Cancel 3 days ahead or pay one night.

fees.source: https://villageofellsworthmi.com/wooden-shoe-campground/ ('45 large sites with water, electric & high-speed wireless internet. $35 Nightly $210 Weekly $630 Monthly $3150 Seasonal (May 15-Sept. 30)', '7 tent sites ... $25 Nightly'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://villageofellsworthmi.com/wooden-shoe-campground/ ('45 large sites with water, electric'), read 2026-10-25. The village gives no amperage; the derived 30 A (note prose of unknown source) is cleared to unknown.

values.note: 45 large RV sites with water and electric, 7 tent sites.

season.source: https://villageofellsworthmi.com/wooden-shoe-campground/ ('Camping can be reserved from May 15 thru September 30'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve by calling the campground (231) 588-6382, by e-mail to office@villageofellsworth.com, or with the village's online Reservation Request Form (staff call back to confirm). Nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays.

booking.source: https://villageofellsworthmi.com/wooden-shoe-campground/ ('For reservations call the campground at (231) 588-6382, e-mail office@villageofellsworth.com or fill out our Reservation Request Form below'), read 2026-10-25

note: Village of Ellsworth municipal campground (6625 Bridge St) overlooking Ellsworth Lake, part of the Chain of Lakes. Beach, boat launch, pavilion and fish-cleaning station at Ellsworth River Park in front of the campground; on-site 24-hour management. --Claude
